name: lazurioexampleorganization-mission-control
description: Lazurio Mission Control: plans, tasks and roadmaps of a Lazurio Organization, over a repository-db data repo.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-template.mjs && bun run app:validate && bun run app:check
scripts.test: bun run check && node --test scripts/check-template.test.mjs scripts/run-v3.test.mjs src/mission-control-data-adapter.test.mjs src/mission-control-publish-flow.test.mjs test-support/native-git.test.mjs test-support/local-ssh-git.test.mjs && bun test test-support/bun-package-execution.test.mjs && bun run app:test
scripts.check:ci: node scripts/check-template.mjs && node scripts/run-v3.mjs validate-fixtures && bun run app:check
scripts.test:ci: bun run check:ci && node --test scripts/check-template.test.mjs scripts/run-v3.test.mjs src/mission-control-data-adapter.test.mjs src/mission-control-publish-flow.test.mjs test-support/native-git.test.mjs test-support/local-ssh-git.test.mjs && bun test test-support/bun-package-execution.test.mjs && bun run app:test
